question: What crest and nāsikā features are described?
premises: eka+deva+sabhā+śīirṣaṃ means with one deva hall crest
ṣaṇ+mahā+nāsikā+anvitam means endowed with six great nāsikās
inference: The structure has one deva-hall crest and six great nāsikās.
plain_english: The structure has one deva-hall crest and six great nāsikās.
